gloss: protective wall; barrier wall; defensive fence

definitions.gloss: protective wall; barrier wall; defensive fence
definitions.explanation: A wall or fence built to protect against wind, noise, fire, or other hazards. Used in construction, urban planning, and general descriptions of protective barriers.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}に{防塀|ぼうへい}を{設置|せっち}した。
examples.english: A protective wall was installed at the construction site.

examples.japanese: {防塀|ぼうへい}のおかげで{騒音|そうおん}がだいぶ{軽減|けいげん}された。
examples.english: Thanks to the barrier wall, the noise was considerably reduced.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}に{備|そな}えて{家|いえ}の{周|まわ}りに{防塀|ぼうへい}を{作|つく}った{農家|のうか}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many farmers built protective walls around their houses in preparation for typhoons.

notes:
Composed of {防|ぼう} (to prevent, to protect against) and {塀|へい} (wall, fence). Part of the productive {防|ぼう}+ noun pattern for protective barriers ({防壁|ぼうへき}, {防風|ぼうふう}{林|りん}, etc.). Refers to a physical structure built for protection rather than a natural barrier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防塀|ぼうへい}を{設置|せっち}する: to install a protective wall
- {防塀|ぼうへい}を{建|た}てる: to erect a barrier wall
- {防音|ぼうおん}{防塀|ぼうへい}: soundproof barrier
- {防塀|ぼうへい}で{囲|かこ}む: to surround with a protective wall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {塀|へい}: wall, fence — a general enclosing wall around a property
- {防壁|ぼうへき}: defensive wall, rampart — often used figuratively or for larger fortification-style walls
- {防風|ぼうふう}{林|りん}: windbreak forest — trees planted as a natural wind barrier
